description: Scenario catalogue for local Aqua OS software validation. These profiles drive the existing deterministic telemetry generator; they are not measurements from a real farm.

scenarios.label: Baseline stable pond
scenarios.purpose: Verify ordinary telemetry updates, charts, freshness badges, and no-false-alarm behavior.
scenarios.expected_result: New telemetry records remain marked simulated; dashboard shows source status clearly.

scenarios.label: Low dissolved oxygen event
scenarios.purpose: Exercise low-DO risk evaluation, action generation, operator decision approval, and post-decision telemetry review.
scenarios.expected_result: The advisory flow identifies the simulated risk; any actuator request is recorded as DRY_RUN only.

scenarios.label: Stale sensor / communication loss
scenarios.purpose: Exercise stale/missing data handling and fail-safe UI behavior.
scenarios.expected_result: Stale telemetry is not treated as healthy; physical actuation remains disabled.

scenarios.label: Aerator failure
scenarios.purpose: Exercise equipment-fault advisories, decision-to-action linking, and command audit history.
scenarios.expected_result: Fault remains synthetic; no physical aerator state is changed.

scenarios.label: Probe fouling / biased reading
scenarios.purpose: Exercise suspect sensor data and uncertainty presentation.
scenarios.expected_result: Data quality concerns are surfaced; the agent does not infer a confirmed biological condition from suspect readings alone.

required_before_physical_commissioning: tested emergency stop circuit independent of software
motor/transformer assignment and load validation by qualified personnel
sensor calibration and farm-approved biological thresholds
commissioning sign-off and a rollback procedure
